A local render now extracts each video at about the size it is shown, so a long export of 4K footage in a 1080p film no longer fills the disk.   • Core: Runtime element handles for the editing channel (e1ddb2e16, #7603).

Fixes

  • CLI: Check hears a WAV whose header misstates its byte rate, as render plays it (97df93fb0, #7618).
  • Docker: Node 22.23.5 for the November 2026 security release (5bf361f52, #7611).
  • Engine: A frame's pixels no longer depend on the frames drawn before it (b4fc4736d, #7181).
  • CLI: Add --dir names the exact init command for a missing folder (bfd3fe644, #7615).
  • Producer: A local render extracts each video at about the size it is shown (54bcdc616, #7609).
  • Engine: Render work is sized by the CPUs the process may use (395c845cd, #7612).
  • Engine: A video shown at exactly half its size is extracted at half size (cc47f7ea7, #7607).

Catalog

  • CLI: 'hyperframes registry search' runs catalog (83b34cbe4, #7610).

Internal

  • Skills: Move the Python encoding guard out of the skills root (33304cff0, #7606).
  • Producer: Pay the first render's start-up cost before the stall and frame-window tests (d1a366b42, #7503).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.37

Released on 2026-11-12.

Sharing refuses to build an archive when it can't read .hyperframesignore, so ignored files stay out. templates pull also refuses archives that hold links.

Fixes

  • CLI: hyperframes templates pull refuses an archive that holds anything other than plain files and folders, such as a symlink, hard link or device entry. Nothing is unpacked, and no partial folder is left behind. A link inside a pulled template could otherwise let preview, render and publish reach files elsewhere on your machine (ab66e5bd7, #7576).
  • Share: snapshotProject and snapshotFiles throw invalid_source_ignore again when .hyperframesignore can't be read. In 0.9.35 they skipped the unreadable file, so an archive built from the snapshot could include files the ignore file meant to leave out. Hosts that use these functions only for change detection should pass { lenientIgnore: true } to keep the 0.9.35 behavior. projectFingerprint already does (35cf03cab, #7573).

item.title: v0.9.35
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.35

Released on 2026-11-11.

Private files like .env and git data stay out of preview bundles, and local sharing only answers your own machine. Sharing also keeps tracking changes when .hyperframesignore uses gitignore patterns.

Fixes

  • Security: Preview bundles never include .env files or git data, even through a link. A render that names one of these files now stops with an error. Local sharing only answers this machine, so sharing from Studio in a container now gets a 403 (a243169f8, #7563).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.31

Released on 2026-11-10.

In Safari, long videos no longer load the whole file at once, and playing clips keep their source. The Studio dev server now checks the Host on its API routes, so a tunnel or remote setup may need one setting.

Fixes

  • Core: In Safari, a small video file keeps its preload, and a clip that is playing keeps its source (cda84222a, #7498).
  • Studio: The Studio dev server now checks the Host header on its API routes too, as the preview server does since 0.9.30. A tunnel, Codespaces or remote dev host that worked before can now get a 403: name the host in HYPERFRAMES_PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOSTS (comma separated), which now also reaches the dev server's own allowed hosts (b0835262a, #7493).
  • Studio Server: Thumbnail links take their origin from the server, and previews from other sites open sandboxed (983e865ad, #7492).
  • Producer: A render that loads the default GSAP file from the CDN uses the copy the CLI already ships, so it works with no network (5c5799975, #7388).
  • CLI: The message about another install shadowing this one only names an install its package manager can move (b28bd2b34, #7499).
  • Studio: Messages that count clips or keyframes say 1 clip, not 1 clips (ec30de062, #7496).
  • Studio Server: When a file is still changing, a claim waits for its first copy, so the edit can still be undone (248f56fba, #7497).

Performance

  • Core: In Safari, the clips of a long video no longer load the whole file at once (fecde9992, #7436).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.9.7

Released on 2026-11-03.

Studio playback no longer freezes WebGL scenes when motion blur is on. Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set cuts into a running tween. Your CLI login now takes priority over an API key left in your shell.

Features

  • Lint: overlapping_gsap_tweens now also flags a set that fires while a tween on the same element and property is still running, a pattern that plays differently from how it scrubs and exports (5e30bbdbe, #7059).
  • Preview: A video the browser cannot play, such as HEVC without a decoder or ProRes, shows its own frame at the playhead instead of black while its playable copy is made. Copy progress is now reported at Full quality too (eb3562966, #6589).

Fixes

  • Studio: With motion blur on, a scene that draws to a WebGL canvas no longer freezes during preview playback. Motion blur now falls back for those scenes, as it already did in renders (112ba5330, #7060).
  • Core: Preview playback now lands on the same frame as a scrub or an export when a set fires inside a running tween on the same property. Before, a word hidden just before its pop-in ended could stay on screen while playing (0f85af7c7, #7061).
  • CLI: hyperframes cloud render no longer offers --page-motion-blur, because the hosted render API rejected requests that used it. Turn motion blur on in the composition with data-motion-blur="on". Local hyperframes render --page-motion-blur is unchanged (dffc640e8, #7062).
  • CLI: A session from hyperframes auth login now takes priority over HEYGEN_API_KEY and HYPERFRAMES_API_KEY, so a key left in your shell no longer replaces the account you signed in with. The key still wins when HEYGEN_API_URL or HEYGEN_API_BASE points at another host, or when the login cannot refresh (d03bdeae9, #7051).
  • Studio Server: Two exports of the same project started within one second now get their own jobs and output files. Before, the second export replaced the first (92943d99f, #7053).
  • CLI: hyperframes snapshot no longer crashes Chrome on a project with many clips cut from one 4K video. Like render, it now stops Chrome from decoding local videos it already replaces with extracted frames (81b93cf05, #6949).
  • CLI: The latestVersion value in --json output is never older than the CLI you are running, even right after an upgrade (8a6636efe, #7049).
  • CLI: hyperframes auth login --device now works without a terminal, such as in a coding agent's shell or an SSH command. It still refuses to run in CI (de2603e63, #7045).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: The reverse skill asks once for a credit top-up that covers the whole run when several steps run out at the same time, and builds its project with init --video (05ddddbbf, #7048).
  • Changelog: Added the weekly update for October 26 to November 2, 2026 (6feb4bec7, #7032).
  • Changelog: The v0.9.6 release notes now list four changes they had missed (4ef8c1de5, #7040).

Internal

  • Studio Server: Raised the package size budget to fit the new preview features (b22af8f25, #7044).

Full changelog
